newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Cash beef market turned higher sooner than expected.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Drop in CME index and higher corn futures call.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Further technical setback but fundamentals firmer than expected.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.200 cent. Still talk of lower cash prices but bullish out-of-town outlook supportive.
